static_axes.evidence: All 13 conditional instructions and six unconditional edges/backedges mapped to source predicates/loops, including both continues, scan backedge, goto found, and adjacent fast path.
end bound; FREE 0x80; movable types 1/3; fast-only attr mask 0x10; unsigned fit; 13-byte name; two-paragraph header; paras-2 copy; merge=1; return 0/1.

segment/end/paras/fit are 16-bit unsigned; type/lock/attr are byte fields; type zero-extends to int; emsOnly signed int used as boolean; size/age are signed 32-bit longs copied unchanged; paras-2 is unsigned 16-bit subtraction.

Outer segment+paras is 16-bit wrapping addition. Inner unsigned-long sum fed to BLK then shifted left 16 retains low 16 segment bits, matching original word add. (long)far_pointer+0x20000L is packed pointer arithmetic by two segment units, not byte-scaled far-pointer addition; negative control detects the alternative.

Seven possible call sites listed with order, far vs same-segment near-via-push-CS, right-to-left word pushes, far-pointer word order, and caller cleanup. Far entry, caller-cleanup, one int arg at BP+6, int result AX; prologue saves BP/DI/SI and allocates 0x26 bytes.
Direct and helper-mediated header/payload/table/free-list/counter writes and ordering are itemized; table publication is bracketed by disable/enable.
